mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 39 degrees with clear skies across our area, including the Military Ridge State Trail, under a New Moon.

The city has two main updates today. First, pavement repairs will affect Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street on November 10 and 11. Second, the Plan Commission is meeting on December 7 to review development projects, including a site plan for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.

We have a busy schedule! You can catch live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, or head to Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow for more performances. Plus, Insight Wellness is hosting yoga tomorrow, and keep an eye out for various trivia nights starting Tuesday at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.

Regarding the weekly report, on October 25, officers located a driver passed out at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue. The 40-year-old man was subsequently arrested for his first offence O W I.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The Culver's of Verona is currently closed but will open today at 10 AM to serve you.
